items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical vulnerability (Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine) that could result in unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this CVE being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including multiple Stored XSS and Incorrect Authorization issues that could lead to privilege escalation and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these specific issues.

items.title: Stored XSS vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that does not require authentication and can lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored XSS vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: Another critical Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that does not require authentication and can lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation (B2B)
items.summary: A critical Incorrect Authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that does not require authentication and can lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that does not require authentication and can lead to a security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that requires authentication and can lead to a security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) and other issues leading to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows for unauthenticated customer account takeover.

items.title: Remote Code Execution via Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: A critical Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type vulnerability (CWE-434) affecting Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source, allowing arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires user interaction.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
items.summary: Adobe Commerce is affected by an Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker with high privileges could exploit this vulnerability.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec found an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension, which could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Auth Bypass)
items.summary: An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (CWE-863) in Adobe Commerce allows a low-privileged authenticated attacker to bypass a security feature and read select data. The CVE was last updated on 2026-06-17.
